market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political activist and MBL leader with no significant electoral base, while the 2026 field is expected to be dominated by major figures like Lula and right-wing governors. Polls consistently show him far outside the top two, making a second-place finish exceptionally unlikely.
evidence_points: Early 2026 polls (e.g., Quaest, Datafolha) show Lula and Tarcísio de Freitas as the top contenders, with Renan Santos not registering support.
Santos has no record of winning major public office and lacks the party machinery or nationwide campaign infrastructure.
In 2022, well-known third-party candidates like Tebet and Gomes only managed <5%, indicating a fringe candidate's ceiling is much lower than 6.7% even for second place.
